title: Use AI as a running coach
hook: Use AI as a running coach
summary: Most free running plans assume you run 6 times a week and never have a bad day.
body: Most free running plans assume you run 6 times a week and never have a bad day.

So I give AI my real week instead: which days I can run, my weekly distance and longest run, the goal, and the other sport I play.
Then I ask for mostly easy runs, rest days, and a plan that adjusts when I miss a week. Because you will.
One rule: AI plans, your body decides. Pain that won't go away is a physio question, not a prompt.
Works in ChatGPT (chatgpt.com) or Claude (claude.ai). Both prompts are on slides 1 and 6, save this for your next block.
Running anything soon? Comment your goal and I'll ask AI for your first week.
guide: Use AI as a running coach without getting injured: give it your real week, ask for easy runs and rest.
